# v0.7.0b3 — Easier setup and more reliable charging

Beta of the integration and app. **0.6.1 remains stable.** Includes the changes
from the incomplete 0.7.0b2 publication.

Changes compared with stable 0.6.1:

- **Optional Waveshare setup:** recognize compatible single-channel adapters,
  configure their communication settings and enable or disable TCP login from
  the integration or app.
- **Clearer settings and documentation:** separate feature menus show only
  selected options, with simpler USB, LAN and service installation guides.
  Vehicle adapters remain independent of manual dates, calendars and HA sensors.
- **More reliable charging:** improved targets, departure planning, tariff
  dialogs and loss estimates. Recovered meters are retried promptly, stale
  pause readings cannot suppress a target stop, and planned commands expire
  or cancel after a confirmed vehicle disconnection. Heartbeat priority and
  cleanup also hold through reconnects and cancelled setup.
- **Connection and access fixes:** sustained heartbeat/service failures create
  self-clearing Repairs. Temporary setup failures retry automatically;
  concurrent connection changes cannot receive an older flow's credentials.
  Unconfirmed app saves block further changes in the running app.
- **Maintenance and packaging:** removed unused helpers, strengthened audits
  and included the complete app connection page. Both processor architectures
  pass container and AppArmor checks.

Keep your existing HA entry and app data. For all shared fixes in service mode,
update the app to **0.7.0b3** through **#apps-beta**, then the integration.
Ordinary service connections still support API 2 and service 0.6.1 or newer;
direct USB/LAN needs no app. **#apps** stays on stable 0.6.1.

TCP login uses the adapter's existing web password. It does not encrypt Modbus
traffic; firmware 1.523 has a documented authentication weakness. See
[supported adapters and recovery limits](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.7.0b3/docs/lan-adapters.md).

[Update guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.7.0b3/docs/upgrading.md)
